project.name: NekoChat Windows Lite
project.purpose: Windows classroom LAN chat, persistent drafts/history and bounded attachments

commands.notes: Use workspace dependencies/dotnet-10.0.403/dotnet, workspace NuGet cache, and a real build/tmp TMPDIR. Tests are console checks, not dotnet test.

shared_modules: windows-lite/NekoChat.Core/Diagnostics: closed fault taxonomy, bounded metadata journal and user-initiated diagnostic-only ZIP export
state_and_data: ChatStore partials serialize immediate SQLite transactions; SchemaGuard verifies normalized DDL; versioned migrations preserve frozen SchemaV1.sql.
Accepted socket source owns classroom principal; draftEpoch prevents stale clear results.
AttachmentService stages generated blob ids, serves source-IP/token-bound 256KiB chunks on the classroom port, and records verified completion separately from offer ACKs.
Migration11 adds Attachment/AttachmentDraft and a clear-only attachmentEpoch. Completed timestamps survive local cache cleanup. Existing text codecs, assets and SchemaV1 remain unchanged.
UI-4 teacher-file index is a read-only, keyset-paged join of incoming Attachment/ClassroomMessage rows to current teacher roster principals and attachmentEpoch; file browsing does not mark chat read.

Migration12 adds immutable signed classroom share/withdraw operations, DPAPI-protected per-share owner credentials and managed blob references. Withdrawal dominates additions, even when received first. Shared catalog is separate from private chat.

ClassroomFileEndpoint adds classroom-files.v1 on the existing listener. Teacher-preferred roster-only anti-entropy; all nodes accept valid operations during teacher absence. Uses AttachmentService vault, file/serve/download gates and listener quota.

WPF file drops route by active pane: private chat stages AttachmentDraft; shared pane uses the same single-file upload path as its picker. Both own rejected FileDrop events to prevent filename fallback.

Known attachment filesystem initialization errors degrade to text/receipt-only runtime with persistent warning and no attachment capability. SQLite/schema failures remain fatal; pending attachment metadata and loading gates prevent silent plaintext sends.

Migration13 adds durable ClassroomOutbox. Only explicit new Send or manual Retry opts content in; background retries never consult live drafts. Per-recipient claims and existing tombstones guard cancellation/deletion. SchemaGuard validates exact V13 DDL.

Viewport reads use the existing foreground/open-pane/geometry and view-generation guards. A newer viewport request that fires while a SQLite read is in flight stays queued; stale writes remain rejected.

Runtime owns a per-profile diagnostic journal separate from SQLite. Typed optional journal parameters connect sender, receiver, storage and attachments; metadata recording never waits for file I/O. UI uses localized codes and a bounded manual export.
Classroom visible reads advance a merged classroom/legacy timeline cursor through unloaded pages; local marks and opt-in receipts commit atomically under the existing view generation guard.
Normal classroom viewport reads skip transactions when the current inbox snapshot has no unread messages; incoming updates refresh the snapshot and retain view-generation guards.

DiagnosticRecoveryPolicy keeps unresolved stage/code failures separate, chooses the most urgent warning and removes only recovered flows. No-runtime diagnostic export uses OpenReadOnly and never starts a writer or rotates history.

Schema v14 backs up pre-upgrade SQLite, atomically auto-adds bounded source-IP contacts with receive/legacy/attachment commits, preserves archive ids, merges v13 queue ownership without changing original targetIp, and enforces a single local teacher. Auto source is not file/pairing trust; label/IP edits preserve it until explicit confirmation.

Migration15 adds explicit local source-IP blocking; immediate writer transactions gate ingress and queued work. Unblock never auto-resumes cancelled work. WPF reads authoritative teacher state, projects Settings with retry, separates archive/blocked lists, and exposes scoped local deletion. Cross-build evidence is separate from unexecuted native UI acceptance.

D-30: blocked valid classroom sends get normal stored ACKs but no local persistence; legacy uses existing delivered and offers use offered, never complete. Blocked receipt ACK is discarded; outgoing receipts recheck local blocking after hello. Receive diagnostics omit identifiers before admission. Classroom UI labels this acknowledgement sent, not proof of remote storage.

Local hiding of blocked classroom-share authors is separate from serving already cached replicas to other permitted nodes. Relay lookup still excludes withdrawn content and keeps source/grant/range/ready checks. WPF notification block queries run on the storage Worker before Dispatcher notification; unknown state suppresses notification without identifiers.

D-31 explicit native contacts smoke runs only in a new safe ui-test-data profile. Per-window auto-dialog hooks require the exact isolated settings/DB root; ordinary prompts retain MessageBox behavior. Shared historical-v13 seed is test-only and refuses overwrite; loopback synthetic sources and seeded transfer states are declared, not LAN/physical acceptance.

Attachment previews require complete persisted metadata or a staged draft, a bounded real file and a same-handle SHA-256 recheck before content-header recognition and WIC. A serial background worker copies only a bounded first-frame thumbnail into detached frozen UI pixels; per-card cancellation and draft generations reject stale results. No new wire fields, persistence states or image actions.

patterns: Focused console checks register in NekoChat.Tests/Program.cs
Classroom listener frames bounded one-request POST connections
error_handling: StoreException maps SQLite errors; transport uses reason codes and UI uses localized text
logging: Diagnostics exclude payloads, IP, credentials, filenames, exception messages and source paths; allow only enum metadata, normalized UUIDs, known exception types and project method frames. Fixed file/queue/ring bounds and memory fallback preserve data-operation outcomes.

invariants: Preserve existing codecs and frozen vectors; attachments use additive endpoint wrapper.

protected_areas.reason: Diagnostic files and export must not expose chat or credentials or change ACK/SQLite outcomes
invariants: No raw exception/message/HTTP/SQL/peer inputs in events
No synchronous file I/O on Record or store callbacks
Bound disk, queue and memory retention; logging failure remains isolated
Export only fixed diagnostic files and metadata; no profile archive

minimum_after_change: consumer regression checks for shared changes
final diff and git status review

For visible-read or inbox changes: Windows native --unread-smoke-test with isolated SQLite, including busy-worker viewport invalidation, hidden/reopen, receipt-off, offscreen unread and restart checks.
Diagnostic changes: --diagnostics, --attachments and Windows --diagnostics-smoke-test, including memory-only log, real SQLite contention, UI refresh queue recovery and diagnostic-only export.

Draft handoff: focused Windows gate must prove the isolated unprotected candidate fails at the exact autosave/Send assertion, then the original product passes the native handoff and synchronous-exit cases.

known_unknowns: Two physical Windows devices, IME, clipboard and other DPI acceptance remain unexecuted for candidate 2.
Classroom replication/failover and withdrawal propagation need multi-device and classroom network acceptance; native single-VM drag/upload/withdraw is verified separately.

evidence.fact: Clipboard/file entrypoints stage real attachments; classroom reactions now resolve only the selected conversation recipient
SchemaGuard derives expected schema from migration SQL
Separate attachment admission/quota preserves default text response bound; only binary responses can reach 256KiB
Attachment test suite uses real TCP/SQLite, hash corruption and forced termination recovery
Teacher-file query excludes classmates/outgoing/unknown sources and survives restart; UI reuses attachment actions and gates visible reads while file catalog is open
Three real TCP/SQLite nodes preserve byte hashes and signed withdrawals across teacher outage/rejoin; sender owns credentials, replicas do not. WPF binds the approved classroom shared view.

Authorized Parallels native Explorer OLE drag verified chat text/image, classroom file bytes/hash, invalid drops and actual withdrawal with refreshed empty list: R11 36 checks, 6 drops. QA only binds Loopback and uses a fresh synthetic profile. Core 6432 and classroom-all 15 suites pass.

Attachment KnownLoopbackFixture uses Pooling=false like ChatStore to release its raw SQLite handle before strict Windows fixture deletion. Success output follows cleanup; classroom-all preserves full error stack traces.

Compact WPF layout preserves Draft>=55 and Send>=40 by reducing outer vertical padding; native smoke captures pre-assert geometry at minimum size and 640/641 sidebar boundaries and verifies visible attachment cleanup settings, not the hidden legacy monitor picker.

Archived signed messaging smoke uses a guarded, roster-backed synthetic reaction recipient; teacher reactions reject classmates, peer stickers use the visible popup, and failure checks target inline attempt cards without fabricating persisted delivered messages. Product recipient/role guards stay unchanged.
Windows startup smoke exercises real runtime/TCP for blocked vault directory, exclusive .part lock, retained/removable pending attachment, text roundtrip, restart recovery and corrupt DB fail-closed.
Local per-message deletion uses scoped transactions and existing ClassroomCleared tombstones; exact pending draft deletion also checks epoch/revision/text and staged attachment absence.
Durable queue, reconnect/restart, ACK loss, independent drafts and attachment byte checks use real SQLite/TCP.

Native WPF unread regression exercises actual list selection and pet reopen paths; a blocked real worker plus resize reproduces a dropped viewport read. Busy reads requeue the latest visible view without bypassing storage guards.

Unified typed failures preserve root-cause frames without exception messages; bounded writer/file rotation and memory fallback are exercised with privacy and ownership tests. UI errors and real TCP/SQLite failures share the same journal.
Read-through tests cover more than 200 rows, merged streams, receipt-off, timestamp ties, pre-COMMIT stale rollback, scopes and restart.
Pure recovery regression covers overlapping persistent/transient failures; read-only export preserves all four generations byte for byte, and unknown custom exception messages map to OtherException.

CT/TC/RR/MD Core scenarios use real SQLite plus controlled protocol peers; receipt processing pages fairly and valid same-peer communication re-arms bounded retries. Receipt defaults and explicit choices/notices migrate under D-28 generation rules.

ClassroomStore and MessageRecovery run v14 using stored principals; historical Inbox v13 is paired with v14 projection/archive scenarios. Blocking v15 has backup and transaction-race coverage. WPF projection and physical acceptance remain unexecuted.

D-30 uses real isolated TCP/SQLite durable text and attachment queues plus receiver row-count and diagnostic ZIP checks; a controlled hello peer tests read-receipt blocking in flight with a positive control. Product loopback guards stay intact; physical/UI acceptance remains separate.

BK-08 explicitly injects failure after real v15 DDL and partial data writes, compares canonical v14 schema/data, reopens v14 and successfully retries v15. BK-03 proves exact cached-byte relay after author blocking while preserving local hiding, grants and signed withdrawal.

Contacts native smoke drives actual forms/menus/teacher projection/archive/block/delete states and captures synthetic WPF UI. CI runs package and portable on windows-2025, requiring JSON isolation flags and captures; actual native results must be checked after PM push, separate from local cross-build.

Fallback peer avatars use stable identity-first UTF-8 SHA-256 and explicit big-endian indexing; distinct real child processes lock mapping and distribution. Existing custom-avatar lookup and nine-coat assets remain first priority; unsynchronized local roster IDs are not shared peer identity.

Message metadata formatting is pure and omits orphan separators; native contacts hardening uses pre-Attach exact-runtime/profile hooks, complete cancellation snapshots, real-input reachability and foreground/read negative-positive controls. Removed roster IDs are excluded from stale UI selection; native additions still require CI execution.

D-32 reaction images default ON; legacy values without explicit choice normalize ON without load-time writes, while visible-toggle choices persist. Shared preview policy retains teacher-only routing; receive transaction and Worker notification block gates stay in place.

D-33 local teacher presentation role resolves before roster TeacherIp projection, with fixed-default-IP startup repair and explicit-choice priority. Student TeacherOnly events are silently retained with a small history annotation; wire-null reaction metadata remains ordinary text. Test local-address injection requires the exact isolated runtime/profile.

D-34 embeds an IP-only 37-student/.240-teacher seed. Sidecar overrides the embedded source; first empty roster/history seeds once, while existing users only add missing IPs after confirmation with snapshot CAS. Explicit add-only choices preserve nicknames/roles and self exclusion uses all local addresses.

Confirmed class roster fill excludes distinct known IPs from RosterRemoved/ClassroomArchivedContact snapshots and reports skips without guessing old endpoint-free snapshots. Explicit-id reaction dispatch uses Find/Notification; the unused ForIncoming helper is removed. Annotation actions overlay the card instead of reserving a blank row.

Content-based image probes bound size and known dimensions before installed WIC decoding. Windows fixtures distinguish actual first-frame thumbnails from explicit missing-codec hints and capture their own window before teardown; synthetic completed receive metadata does not claim network-transfer acceptance.

Incoming attachment offers allocate a receiver-local blob ID independently of the sender wire ID. Native preview fixtures must reserve/commit bytes under the returned receiver record before marking completion; a complete record lacking its local path shows a fixed verification hint rather than silent NotEligible. Real TCP PNG regression pins canonical complete state, local path, lowercase hex SHA and content-based preview eligibility.

Preview decoder availability comes from content-independent WIC CreateDecoder(container GUID), recording the selected component CLSID, not a generic image exception. All eight formats use the same Registered/NotRegistered/Unknown policy: only definitive missing registration is DecoderUnavailable; registered corrupt data and unknown queries remain DecodeFailed. Native inventory is saved before per-file decoding and unknown registration fails the smoke.

PM r15 classifies only WINCODEC_ERR_COMPONENTINITIALIZEFAILURE (0x88982F8B) during a format-specific decoder query as InitializeFailed and operationally DecoderUnavailable, with no pixel decode. It is distinct from NotRegistered and Unknown; neighboring/other unknown HRESULTs still fail native smoke. Observations preserve exact registration/error and represent unavailable vs unproven registration separately.

D-36 deliberately excludes ICO attachment previews by content before any product WIC query/decode, returning explicit NotSupported and a fixed save-as hint even when the ICO embeds PNG pixels. ICO stays in native fixture/informational inventory and must prove hint/no-decode/no-image with a screenshot; PNG/JPEG/GIF/TIFF/BMP remain strict Ready controls, WebP/HEIF follow confirmed availability.

Automatic installer handoff runs only after PrepareForShutdownAsync and runtime disposal. A failed draft save never launches the installer. Headless updates wait for the old PID and abort on timeout without killing it; manual install process closure stays separate. Native package/portable fixtures exercise save failure, launch failure, committed drafts and idempotent unread-notice restoration.

The GitHub introduction is maintained in README.md, README.en.md and README.ja.md. Voice Input beta.3 and Lite beta.15 have separate download/update instructions. Detailed Chinese voice guidance lives in docs/VOICE-GUIDE.zh-TW.md. README image provenance and checksums are recorded in docs/media/README.md.
